author: Plastic-Band-5968
body:
It's been quite a while since I was around T5, so I may not be completely up to date with the current early-game meta. That said, this is the path that worked well for me:

\- Class: Cavalry  
\- Specialization: Berserker

I wouldn't stick with Lancer as your specialization.

For gear:

\- Weapon: Whatever has the highest Attack (Legendary/Ornate if you get lucky).  
\- Off-hand: Arcane Arrows. Volley II is incredibly strong at this stage, even if you're aiming for a full warrior/melee playstyle later.  
\- Accessories: Crystal Eyes or anything that gives Attack/HP.

Skills:

\- Berserk  
\- Volley II  
\- Tricut (if you have it)  
\- Stun Dart  
\- First Aid / Mend  
\- Elemental Strike II (swap depending on the enemy's weakness)

Pet:

1. Wisp
2. Fairy
3. Greater Fairy

I also wouldn't worry too much about optimizing gear at this level. You'll replace equipment very quickly while leveling, so I wouldn't spend too many resources upgrading T5 gear. Focus on getting the best weapon you can, save your Orns for future classes, and enjoy the ride.

And don't feel bad about using Arcane Arrows. Volley II was incredibly efficient around this tier, and a lot of warrior players used it. You can always transition into a more traditional melee build later on.

author: screwyoujor
body: Learn how to level using world bosses. Takes some prep but leveling goes much faster after you do. Monster tomes/exp potion/astreel tree exp bonus/buy a wisdom shrine from the quest guild/best time to use gold and silver coins. Then go kill world bosses that you can take down quickly for an hour.  Skills and spells are shared and useable after unlocking a class so look for the best ward but then you can swap back if you liked another class better and still use that ward.
